title: Let an operator resolve a closed meeting synthesis review and read the durable result

incident.stored_synthesis: Synthesis empty or unreadable; recorded as REVIEW with no proposal.

request_body.note: string (required, trimmed non-empty, <= 2000 Unicode characters; serialized operator_review object <= 16384 UTF-8 bytes so 2000 ASCII, CJK, or 4-byte emoji characters are accepted with HTTP 200 and >2000 characters rejected with HTTP 422 review_note_too_long)

operator_review_shape.cause: string ('unknown' on legacy rows without stored cause; specific stored cause when present)

privacy_and_trader_visibility.private_memory_withholding: Consistent _is_private_meeting_item / _is_private_memory_item filtering across source (list_meetings_view, get_meeting_detail_view) and BFF (shape_meeting_list_item, shape_meeting_detail, project_human_inbox_meeting_items) checks all private scope keys (relevance_scope, memory_layer, scope, visibility_scope, memory_scope), boolean flags (is_private, private), and private kind/type/owner markers on case_file_items, case_file groups, pre_read, round positions, agora_records, attribution_record, and evidence_refs, stripping withheld item IDs and private position citations before flattening evidence_refs.
privacy_and_trader_visibility.trader_scope_filtering: Agora/trader-scoped records and private_servant round positions are withheld from flattened source list/detail evidence_refs by default and included in BFF shaped detail/list/inbox evidence_refs and round citations only for operators (is_operator=True) or the owning trader (caller_user_id == trader_id).

human_inbox_projection.pending_before_review: meeting_review:{meeting_id} projected in GET /bff/management/human-inbox with status='pending', gate='meeting_review', can_proceed=false, evidence_refs, and unreadable_reason/cause context
human_inbox_projection.after_review: meeting_review:{meeting_id} leaves the pending GET /bff/management/human-inbox queue while GET /bff/management/meetings/{meeting_id} and GET /bff/meetings/{meeting_id} return operator_review.status='reviewed' and preserve outcome='REVIEW', synthesis, transcript/rounds, and proposals=[]

concurrency_and_idempotency.identical_retry: HTTP 200 with identical operator_review (preserving first reviewed_by and reviewed_at) and replayed=true (zero duplicate lifecycle/audit/outbox writes)
concurrency_and_idempotency.partial_write_failure_recovery: If outbox.append or append_audit raises an OSError after the lifecycle event is written (or across a process restart), in-memory and replayed state preserves the first operator and timestamp, rejects conflicting operators with HTTP 409, and an identical retry repairs the missing outbox record (via _has_outbox_for_lifecycle_event) and/or missing audit record (via _ensure_meeting_review_audit) leaving exactly 1 review lifecycle event, 1 outbox record, and 1 meeting_review_recorded audit event
concurrency_and_idempotency.wrong_tenant: HTTP 403 tenant_scope_mismatch / BFF_ERR_TENANT_SCOPE (404 when meeting_id is in another tenant)

runtime_storage_budget.cadence: On-demand authenticated operator action only. At hosted scale (3 enrolled trading personas, <= 3 meetings/persona/ISO week = <= 9 meetings/week total), at most 1 non-replayed review write can occur per closed REVIEW meeting.
runtime_storage_budget.count_cap: At most 1 persisted operator_review lifecycle upsert, 1 ConsultAuditEvent (action='meeting_review_recorded'), and 1 OutboxRecord (idempotency_key='consult-lifecycle:<event_id>') per closed REVIEW meeting. Identical retries verify outbox and audit presence and short-circuit as replayed=true without duplicate writes; conflicting writes are rejected by both record_meeting_operator_review and ConsultationStore._validate_meeting_operator_review_write.
runtime_storage_budget.growth_per_day_at_hosted_scale: With 3 enrolled trading personas (<= 9 meetings/week, ~1.3 meetings/day), each persona_meeting lifecycle upsert and outbox envelope stores a full meeting snapshot (~15-40 KB base snapshot, up to ~45-56 KB with a max 2000-char Unicode operator_review <= 16 KB). Even if 100% of meetings closed with outcome=REVIEW, operator review dispositions add at most ~1.3 full-snapshot lifecycle upserts/day (~20-75 KB/day worst case), ~1.3 full-snapshot outbox records/day (~20-75 KB/day worst case), and ~1.3 compact audit rows/day (~400-600 B each, < 1 KB/day).
runtime_storage_budget.retention_and_cleanup: Whole-writer historical row/byte retention and compaction for the existing append-only consultation JSONL journals and SQL tables remain tracked as unreviewed under RC3 WP3.1 (startup replay into in-memory state and duplicate suppression do not delete or compact historical lines/rows on disk). For this incremental field, unchanged put_meeting writes and idempotent operator_review retries are suppressed before appending a new lifecycle, outbox, or audit record.

acceptance_probes_and_tests.read_only_probe_guarantee: Uses GET-only viewer endpoints (/bff/management/meetings, /bff/management/meetings/{id}, /bff/meetings/{id}, /bff/management/human-inbox) and never sends POST /review or mutates the user's real meeting mtg-2c016da5651a0dc4.
